chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ʿAbdillah, from Muhammad ibn Sinan, who said:

I entered upon Abu Al-Hasan (عليه السلام), and he said: “O Muhammad, an event has occurred to the family of Faraj.” So I said, “ʿUmar has died.” He said: “All praise is for Allah,” until I counted for him twenty-four times. So I said: “My master, had I known that this would please you, I would have come to you barefoot, running.”

He said: “O Muhammad, do you not know what he — may Allah curse him — said to Muhammad ibn ʿAli, my father?” He said: I said, “No.” He said: “He spoke to him regarding something, and then said, ‘I think you are intoxicated.’ So my father said: ‘O Allah, if You know that I have reached the evening fasting for You, then make him taste the bitterness of war and the humiliation of captivity.’”

So by Allah, not many days passed before his wealth and all that he possessed were ruined; then he was taken captive, and now he has died — may Allah not have mercy on him. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, took vengeance against him, and He continues to grant victory to His friends over His enemies.

key_terms.أَدَالَ اللَّهُ: Allah granted turn, redress, or victory against him
key_terms.أَوْلِيَاءَهُ: His devoted friends or allies, meaning those loyal to Allah
key_terms.الْحَرْبِ: warfare or destructive conflict invoked in the supplication
key_terms.اَلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ: an expression of praise and gratitude to Allah
key_terms.صَائِمًا: fasting for the sake of Allah
key_terms.لَعَنَهُ اللَّهُ: a curse invocation against the offending person

ai.seo_question: Why did Abu Al-Hasan (عليه السلام) praise Allah upon hearing of ʿUmar’s death in this narration from al-Kafi?
ai.summary: This report narrates an encounter with Abu Al-Hasan (عليه السلام) concerning the death of a man from the family of Faraj and explains the Imam’s reaction by recalling the man’s insult toward Imam Muhammad ibn ʿAli (عليه السلام). It also recounts the supplication made by the Imam’s father and the subsequent downfall, captivity, and death of that individual as a manifestation of divine support for Allah’s awliya'.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Sinan who said,

‘I went over to Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup>, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Muhammad! And occurrence has taken place with the family of Faraj, an event’. So I said, ‘Umar died’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Praise is for Allah<sup>azwj</sup>’, to the extent that I counted for him<sup>asws</sup> twenty-four times’. So I said, ‘My Master<sup>asws</sup>! Had I know that this would cheer you<sup>asws</sup> up, I could have come (running) barefoot congratulating to you<sup>asws</sup>’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Muhammad! Or don’t you know what he, may the Curse of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> be upon him, said to Muhammad Bin Ali<sup>asws</sup>, my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>?’ I said, ‘No’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> addressed him regarding something, so he said, ‘I think you<sup>asws</sup> are intoxicated’. So my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! If You<sup>asws</sup> Know that I<sup>asws</sup> am Fasting for You<sup>azwj</sup>, so Make him taste the consumption of the war, and humiliation of the imprisonment’.

So, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! (Only a few) days passed until his wealth was ruined and whatever was for him, then he was seized as a prisoner, and he has that who has died. May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> no have Mercy on him, and Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic has Triumphed from him, and He<sup>azwj</sup> does not Cease to Cause His<sup>azwj</sup> friends to triumph upon His<sup>azwj</sup> enemies’.
en.sarwar: 8. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from Salj ibn Ziyad from Ali ibn al-Hakam who has said the following.

“Di‘bil ibn Ali once went to see abu al-Hassan al-Rida (a.s.) and he ordered his people to give him a certain gift but he did thank Allah.” The narrator has said that the Imam (a.s.) said to him, “Why did you not thank Allah?”
The narrator has said that then I went to see abu Ja‘far (a.s.) and ordered his people to give a gift and I said, “All praise belongs to Allah.”
The Imam (a.s.) said, “You just demonstrated your discipline.”
